# Find your country

One page per country. Each starts with the values to give OG-Core, then shows where they come from. Countries with a census-based adult-mortality measurement are marked; every other country uses the [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md) for adult mortality.

Not listed? The country has no wealth-quintile survey in the library: borrow its region's median from [Findings](../../ANALYSIS.md#2-how-steep-region-by-region) and say that you did.
